LESSON: READING 8.2.1 READING FOR INTERPRETATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Interpretation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Interpretation. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to understand the point of view in a poem?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the point of view in a poem

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the point of view in a poem
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the point of view in a poem. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Interpretation using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Interpretation in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Interpretation to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Interpretation.
4. Show that you can: identify the point of view in a poem

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Interpretation using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 8.2.1 Reading for Interpretation important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a given poem and identify the point of view,
2. Listen to poems read by the teacher,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the point of view in a poem

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
